situations.title: 검체 용기 라벨 부착
situations.tagline: I'm labeling the specimen container now—let's confirm the details.
situations.brief: 검체 용기에 라벨을 정확히 기재하세요.
keyPhrases: I'm labeling this container with the patient's name.
This is gallbladder, correct?
I'll add the date and time on the label.

situations.title: 조직명 구두 확인
situations.tagline: Let's say the specimen name out loud together before I bag it.
situations.brief: 검체 종류를 소리 내어 구두로 확인하세요.
keyPhrases: Can you confirm this is the appendix?
Let's read it out loud together.
I'll write down exactly what you say.

situations.title: 검체 보존액 선택
situations.tagline: Does this specimen go in formalin, or does the lab want it fresh in saline?
situations.brief: 검체에 맞는 보존액을 포르말린과 생리식염 중 선택하세요.
keyPhrases: Should this go in formalin or saline?
The lab wants it fresh for this test.
I'll confirm the fixative with pathology.

situations.title: 검체 전달 기록
situations.tagline: I'm handing off the specimen—let's record who took it and when.
situations.brief: 검체 인계 과정을 정확히 기록하세요.
keyPhrases: I'm handing off two specimens now.
Can you sign that you received them?
I'll log the time and your name.

situations.title: 냉동절편 검체 준비
situations.tagline: This one's going for frozen section—let's get it to the lab right away.
situations.brief: 냉동절편 검체를 신속히 준비하세요.
keyPhrases: This is for frozen section—no fixative.
The surgeon is waiting on the result.
I'll call the lab that it's on the way.

situations.title: 검체 방향 표시
situations.tagline: Can you mark the orientation so pathology knows which margin is which?
situations.brief: 검체의 방향을 정확히 표지하세요.
keyPhrases: Which suture marks the superior margin?
Let's mark the orientation clearly.
I'll note it on the requisition for pathology.

situations.title: 라벨 정보 불일치
situations.tagline: The label and the requisition don't match—let's stop and reconcile them.
situations.brief: 환자 정보와 검체 라벨을 대조해 불일치를 조정하세요.
keyPhrases: The name on the label doesn't match the requisition.
Let's verify against the patient's chart.
I won't send it until this is corrected.

situations.title: 냉동절편 신속 이송
situations.tagline: The surgeon's waiting on this frozen—I need it in the lab's hands now.
situations.brief: 냉동절편 검체를 신속하게 전달하세요.
keyPhrases: This frozen needs to go now.
Please run it straight to pathology.
Call me the moment you have a result.

situations.title: 배양 검체 무균 채취
situations.tagline: Let's collect this culture with a sterile technique so we don't contaminate it.
situations.brief: 배양 검체를 무균적으로 채취해 오염을 방지하세요.
keyPhrases: Let's use a fresh sterile swab for the culture.
Avoid touching the edges of the container.
I'll get it to micro before it dries out.

situations.title: 다수 검체 혼동 방지
situations.tagline: We have several specimens—let's label each one separately as it comes off the field.
situations.brief: 다수 검체를 구분해 혼동을 방지하세요.
keyPhrases: Let's label each specimen one at a time.
This is specimen A, left; specimen B, right.
I'll confirm each before the next comes off.

situations.title: margin 방향 보존
situations.tagline: Let's keep the margin orientation intact so pathology can read the edges correctly.
situations.brief: 절제연 표지를 유지해 margin 방향을 보존하세요.
keyPhrases: The stitch marks the lateral margin.
Let's keep the orientation sutures in place.
I'll document the margins on the requisition.

situations.title: 검체 크기·개수 기록
situations.tagline: Let's confirm the size and count of these specimens before I document them.
situations.brief: 검체의 크기와 개수를 정확히 기록하세요.
keyPhrases: How many pieces are we sending?
Let's confirm three fragments total.
I'll record the size and count on the form.

situations.title: 특수 검체 취급 지침
situations.tagline: This is a special specimen—let's confirm the lab's handling instructions first.
situations.brief: 특수 검체의 취급 지침을 확인해 처리하세요.
keyPhrases: This specimen needs special handling.
Does it go on ice or in a specific media?
I'll confirm the protocol with the lab.

situations.title: 검체 손상 방지 이송
situations.tagline: Let's handle this gently so the specimen isn't crushed on the way to the lab.
situations.brief: 검체가 손상되지 않게 이송하세요.
keyPhrases: Let's not compress the specimen.
Place it flat so it doesn't fold.
Carry it steady to pathology.

situations.title: 병리 요청서 일치
situations.tagline: Let's make sure the requisition matches the specimen exactly before it goes.
situations.brief: 병리 요청서의 정보가 검체와 일치하는지 확인하세요.
keyPhrases: Does the requisition match the specimen label?
Let's confirm the site and side.
I'll fix any discrepancy before sending.

situations.title: 라벨 없는 검체 발견
situations.tagline: This specimen has no label—we have to stop and identify it before anything else.
situations.brief: 미표지 검체를 발견하면 즉시 확인 절차를 밟으세요.
keyPhrases: This container has no label.
Stop—we can't send an unlabeled specimen.
Let's identify it now with the surgeon.

situations.title: 검체 분실 즉시 대응
situations.tagline: A specimen is missing—we need to stop, report, and search right now.
situations.brief: 검체 분실 시 즉시 보고하고 수색하세요.
keyPhrases: One specimen is unaccounted for.
Let's stop and search the field and containers.
I'm reporting this to the surgeon and pathology now.

situations.title: 냉동절편 결과 수술 변경
situations.tagline: The frozen came back positive—the surgeon's extending the resection, so let's prep for it.
situations.brief: 냉동절편 결과에 따라 확대 수술에 대응하세요.
keyPhrases: The frozen margins are positive.
We're extending the resection—let's set up.
I'll prep additional specimen containers.

situations.title: 오염 검체 재채취
situations.tagline: This culture got contaminated—we need a fresh, sterile re-collection.
situations.brief: 오염된 검체를 확인하고 재채취하세요.
keyPhrases: This sample touched a non-sterile surface.
Let's discard it and re-collect cleanly.
I'll open a new sterile kit.

situations.title: 잘못된 환자 라벨
situations.tagline: This label has the wrong patient's name—we have to correct it immediately.
situations.brief: 오라벨을 발견하면 즉시 정정하세요.
keyPhrases: This label belongs to another patient.
Stop—do not send this until it's corrected.
Let's re-verify identity and relabel now.

situations.title: 대체 불가 검체 위기
situations.tagline: This is the only specimen we'll ever get—let's protect it at every step.
situations.brief: 대체 불가능한 유일 검체를 안전하게 사수하세요.
keyPhrases: This specimen can't be replaced.
Two of us will confirm every handoff.
I'll hand-carry it to pathology myself.
